top_signals.title: GE Vernova To Pay $9 Billion for Grid Supplier Trench Group
top_signals.summary: GE Vernova Inc. agreed to pay $9 billion to acquire Trench Group in a deal aimed at bolstering its portfolio of high-voltage power grid equipment to meet the surging demand for electricity.
